Auth.loginSubtitle: Use your Ibadah credentials to enter the operations console.

Dashboard.description: A live snapshot of system health, user activity, content volume, moderation queue and recent privileged actions.
Dashboard.auditSummary: privileged actions in the last 7 days
Dashboard.engagementDescription: Daily active users (distinct authenticated users with worship logged) and total points across all pillars.

Analytics.title: Application analytics
Analytics.description: Time-series engagement, full pillar breakdown across salah, quran, habits, checklist and dhikr, plus a system-wide score distribution. All metrics scoped to the chosen date range.
Analytics.computing: Computing analytics over the chosen window…
Analytics.engagementCardDesc: Distinct users who logged any worship that day vs new accounts created.
Analytics.pointsCardDesc: How much score is being generated each day, broken down by pillar.
Analytics.contentCardDesc: Quran pages read and dhikr recitations across all users.
Analytics.salahDistDesc: Across every Fard prayer logged in the window. The donut shows on-time vs late/missed; the legend gives the absolute breakdown.
Analytics.scoreDistDesc: How many users fall in each score bucket over this window. Long-tail to the right means power users; mass at zero means low engagement.
Analytics.topDhikrDesc: Aggregate recitation counts across all users in the window.

Onboarding.title: Mobile onboarding
Onboarding.description: Preferences collected when visitors complete the mobile landing onboarding flow — persona, focus areas, and locale.
Onboarding.noSubmissions: No onboarding submissions match your filters
Onboarding.noSubmissionsHint: Submissions appear here when mobile visitors complete the landing onboarding flow.

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.description: Every privileged action recorded by the server: who did what, to whom, and when. Read-only and append-only.
Audit.noEvents: No audit events match your filters
Audit.noEventsHint: Privileged actions (suspending users, defaults updates, moderation decisions) are recorded here in real time.

Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.description: The most active users by total score over a chosen window. Read-only — administrators do not edit user data.
Leaderboard.noActivityHint: Try a longer date range, or check back once users have logged some worship.

Moderation.title: Content moderation
Moderation.description: Review user-generated content (habit names, checklist items, dhikr labels) for inappropriate or spammy submissions. Approve to keep, hide to soft-remove, or remove to scrub.
Moderation.pendingBreakdownDesc: Where the queue currently sits, by content type.
Moderation.queueHint: Run the auto-scan to surface anything that needs a closer look.
Moderation.confirmRemove: Permanently scrub this content? The host record will be replaced with [removed by moderator].

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.profileHint: These values are stored on your account via /users/me. Changes here also update the header dropdown instantly.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.avatarPlaceholder: https://… or paste an image data URL
Settings.avatarHint: Pick a file with the camera button, paste an external URL, or clear to remove the picture.
Settings.localeHintEn: Default UI language for the operations console.
Settings.timezoneHint: Used for "today" boundaries in admin charts and reports.

System.title: System
System.description: Live operational status, infrastructure metrics and traffic counters. Auto-refreshing every 15 seconds.
System.activeUsersHint: Distinct authenticated users observed in the last 24h / 7d / 30d.
System.apiSurfaceHintBefore: Endpoints this admin panel currently consumes. All marked
System.apiSurfaceHintAfter: now that the admin API has shipped.

Users.title: Users
Users.description: Authenticated users we've seen interact with the application within the chosen window. Most-recent first. Use the View action to inspect or moderate any individual user.
Users.noActivityHint: Either the window is too narrow or no one has authenticated yet.

Assistant.title: AI copilot
Assistant.description: Ask the admin copilot about any page or endpoint, or paste metrics and have them visualized inline. Powered by your configured AI provider — no user data is sent automatically.
Assistant.greeting: Hi — I am the Ibadah admin copilot. Ask about any page, paste metrics for a chart, or describe a question and I will point you at the right endpoint.
Assistant.suggest_engagement: Chart DAU vs WAU vs MAU
Assistant.suggest_endpoint: Where is the audit log endpoint?
Assistant.suggest_moderation: Walk me through the moderation queue
